## Why This Is Asked
This question probes production-grade multi-tenant data contracts, real-time masking, and governance across regions.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant isolation and contracts in Event Hubs and Delta Lake
- Real-time masking/UDFs and compliant data sharing
- Purview RBAC, BYOK, DR to paired region, cost levers

## Code Example
```python
# Pseudo: apply per-tenant masking in Spark
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, when

def mask_value(df, colname):
    return df.withColumn(colname, when(col(colname).rlike('email|ssn'), '***MASKED***').otherwise(col(colname)))
```
